card.name: Zero digit inside 20xx years
card.fires_on: The digit 0 right after '20' in a year or ID number, such as 2005 or 2003 in citations and copyright lines. Weaker on a few words in disclaimer text like 'treat' or 'of' after 'diagnosis or treatment'.
